projects.name: HeyGen Code2Video Benchmark (distinct from ShowLab)
projects.release_status: Kaggle public split v5 inspected through browser: 50 tasks, 409 files including 50 MP4 and 55 Python files. server/server.py actual source preview read. No dataset downloaded or script executed.
projects.format: Harbor tasks; single index.html HTML/GSAP, HyperFrames render, golden reference video.
projects.metrics: Five axes: engagement, prompt intent, composition, temporal consistency, craft; Bradley-Terry Elo and task-clustered bootstrap intervals.
projects.caveat: Public server/server.py is a batching proxy, not local Judge weights. Requires HEYGEN_API_KEY, SERVER_SECRET, GCS_BUCKET and Google Cloud storage credentials; sends comparisons to HeyGen /v3/video-quality/comparisons/batches. API eligibility, price, and reproducibility of company-reported Judge results are unverified. Data card calls it VLM judging; server code does not reveal Judge internals. Polling/batching adds wall-clock latency beyond reported model inference time.
projects.priority: High for craft/short-motion tasks, auxiliary to educational comprehension.
source_verified: server/server.py (7.24 kB, public dataset v5 browser source preview)
